claims.statement: EU Regulation 2023/1542 requires an electronic battery passport from 18 February 2027 for each LMT battery, EV battery and industrial battery above 2 kWh placed on the market or put into service.
The passport's restricted individual-battery data includes state of health, status, charge cycles, negative events and operating conditions.
When a battery becomes waste, the regulation transfers responsibility for specified passport obligations to the producer, producer-responsibility organization or selected waste operator.

contrary_evidence: Manufacturers and passport vendors may provide lifecycle and warranty workflows as part of compliance.
The regulation restricts reuse of passport data by service operators, limiting data-moat strategies unless consent and purpose are carefully designed.

economics.acquisition_route: Use a renewable installer as design partner, then sell white-label to storage distributors that activate the ledger at commissioning
economics.founder_net_worth_path: Hypothesis: 70,000 monitored commercial batteries at 70 PLN blended annual revenue plus transfer fees yields 5-7m PLN ARR by years 6-8. Majority ownership, 20%+ margins and a 4-6x data-software value could cross 5m PLN founder net worth in years 7-9.
economics.founder_time: 15-22 hours weekly; hardware protocol work is bounded to one battery family in the pilot
economics.gross_margin_basis: Hypothesis: 75-90%; API data is high-margin, while physical diagnostics are performed by certified partners and passed through
economics.payback: Hypothesis: 6-12 months for a distributor cohort; economics fail if activation remains one-off without monitoring revenue
economics.pricing: Hypothesis: 20-80 PLN per commercial battery-year, 150-600 PLN per enhanced transfer packet and 1,500-5,000 PLN monthly organization minimum
economics.retention_or_repeat: Battery evidence persists across years, service events and transfers; downstream counterparties are invited into the same asset record

fingerprint.compounding_advantage: Longitudinal state-of-health, operating-event and warranty-resolution dataset by model and use case improves anomaly detection, residual-value estimates and partner trust
fingerprint.customer: EU commercial battery distributors, renewable-storage installers, O&M providers and second-life operators
fingerprint.distribution_mechanism: Bundle at battery commissioning through distributors and renewable installers, then invite downstream service and second-life parties through each transfer packet
fingerprint.offer_and_business_model: Asset-level evidence ledger, workflow API and white-label handoff portal priced per battery and service organization
fingerprint.payer_and_paid_event: Distributor or service provider pays per active battery-year and per signed handoff packet; buyer may pay for enhanced independent diagnostics
fingerprint.problem_trigger: A battery is commissioned, fails, changes owner/status, is repurposed or becomes waste and the parties disagree about condition, warranty responsibility or missing evidence

founder_fit: Direct leverage from the family renewable-installation business for workflow observation and a pilot channel.
Sensor and longitudinal-data work fits the founder's biosignal/data background.
A single battery family constrains capital and supports part-time execution.
risks: Battery telemetry is safety-sensitive and may be proprietary or inconsistent.
Residual-value outputs could be mistaken for guarantees unless tightly caveated.
The 2027 deadline and implementing details can shift partner priorities.

structure.control_point: Commissioning, warranty approval and ownership/status handoff of an individual battery
structure.critical_dependency: Permissioned access to battery-management data and manufacturer passport identifiers, plus clear separation from the obligated operator's legal passport duty

thesis: Build a battery-passport companion for commercial storage installers, distributors, service firms and second-life buyers that captures commissioning baseline, service events, state-of-health evidence, warranty exceptions and signed status handoffs. At resale, repurposing or waste transfer it produces a bilateral condition and responsibility packet tied to the passport identifier. Begin with stationary batteries above 2 kWh sold by a Polish installer/distributor channel, while the manufacturer remains responsible for official passport compliance. Longitudinal condition and resolution data can become the underwriting-quality asset without initially offering insurance.
title: Battery Handoff Liability Ledger
uncertainties: Installer access to model-specific state-of-health data
Who controls permission for longitudinal passport data after transfer
Annual willingness to pay versus a one-time commissioning fee
